description.value: Walmart Supercenter (store #1036) is a large-format retailer on Crawford Avenue in Merritt, BC, offering a full grocery department alongside general merchandise including clothing, electronics, and household goods. For a touring cyclist passing through the interior of BC, it is one of the most comprehensive one-stop resupply points on the Coquihalla corridor. The Supercenter format typically includes a pharmacy, vision centre, and photo department inside a single large building.
